value.meaning: The selected raster/vector import mode for a matching process-local resource identity. Physical checkbox1 is not mode1: vector without styles and Collector use that widget with semantic mode2. The checkbox is not remote resource ID, a layer edit permission or geometry selection.

Compact JSON save records account/server/remote path and modes; each restore resolve obtains new localID before same-ID OR merge.
value.units: Boolean mode flags plus process-local int identity; remote NGW long IDs/account/path are separate. No coordinates, CRS, geometry or screen-position interpretation.
updates: Each supported row bind sets a total requested-mode value once without mutating checks; raster/WMS/webmap labels reset on every relevant recycling bind.

False callback clears requested mode in every matching localID entry and removes only entries nowbothfalse. True preserves an existing positive mode; otherwise updates first matching entry or creates one. Other IDs/modes/order/object identity are retained.
Every compact JSON entry resolves and parses its original flags before OR same resolved localID into first newly owned check; different IDs/accounts and first order remain distinct.
actions: Choose the raster or vector/import mode, then use existing import action. Raster/vector flags are consumed independently by both unchanged import loops.
A later invalid duplicate still fails restore; no dedup shortcut may skip resolve/parse or turn missing/network/cancel into success.
conditions: PostGIS login guard, resource masks, existing type-to-mode assignments, import leases and raster/vector/Collector producers are preserved.
Public setter and legacy Parcel list are not normalized; externally supplied positive duplicates may still yield repeated import side effects. Checkbox consistency is not generic import dedup.
Falsefalse-only restored record retains legacy entry behavior; no new JSON schema, persistent migration, account merging or credential storage.
value.saved_state: JSON uses account/server plus remote path and raster/vector flags, not old local IDs. CheckState Parcelable keeps local int ID and two booleans; Activity still accepts legacy tree/states, whereas Dialog without compact JSON reconstructs accounts/root and clears checks. Setter/Parcel normalization and refresh policy are excluded.
expectations: Checked matching mode followed by an unrelated row remains checked regardless of list order; empty/missing selection resets a recycled checked widget without firing old listener.
Both modes stay independent; uncheck clears every matching requested positive, while check does not amplify duplicates and preserves other modes/IDs/order/objects.
Recycled vector/Collector -> raster/WMS/webmap uses owned raster label and correct mode; physical checkbox1 can carry mode2.
Owned JSON duplicate selection resolves every entry then ORs same localID in first order. Same remoteID in different accounts stays separate; missing or malformed later duplicate still fails.

caption_layout.meaning: Три caption width=wrap_content сохраняют полный owned RU/EN текст. NgwResourceRowLayout сначала измеряет обычную горизонтальную строку; лишь фактический glyph clipping имени переводит две статические header/mode группы друг под друга. Перед обычным и full-width измерением локально forceLayout для каждого descendant обновляет getLayout до решения о размещении; parent requestLayout/reparent нет. При расширении та же строка возвращается в горизонтальную компоновку. Шрифт, IDs, порядок controls, listeners/CheckState/local-vs-remote identity/JSON/Parcel/import/refresh прежние.
